East is a different-looking enclosed unit: a pale concrete or stone housing with a vent grille, an amber lamp, a small door and an elbow pipe stub; a dark blue-grey steel hood with a yellow dashed stripe on its top panel; a chain drum visible through an opening; and two chain runs leaving to the right. No red anywhere.
observed.south.png: An open chain-drum winch seen from the front and a little above, so the top of the base plate shows. The steel frame is dark slate blue-grey with lit highlights, the flanges are bright brushed steel, the chain is black iron and the gearbox is mid grey. Clean alpha, no shadow.
observed.east.png: Side view of the winch as an enclosed housing: concrete-coloured body panels, a slate-blue steel cowl over the drum with a yellow dashed marking strip on the top, the chain drum inside, and two chain lengths running out to the east edge. observed.north.png: Mirror of south: the gearbox and motor are on the left and the drum on the right, with the same blue-grey frame and steel chain. No backdrop.
